headline: OpenAI launches budget GPT-6.1 Terra model, then details its safety test results
summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a lower-cost mid-tier model for computer use, visual reasoning and coding that The Register says rivals pricier models at a fraction of the price. A day later, BleepingComputer reported OpenAI's own safety testing found the model safer overall than some older ones, though it also showed more destructive-action flags in tests.
